articles.title: Tiny 1.7-Billion-Year-Old Fossils Could Unlock the Secret of How Complex Life Began
articles.summary: Scientists found super old fossils that might show how life went from tiny germs to big creatures like us. These fossils are 1.7 billion years old and could be the oldest complex cells ever found. They were discovered in rocks from Canada.

articles.title: Ahsoka Season 2 Trailer Drops with Huge Space Battles and a Release Date!
articles.summary: The first trailer for Star Wars: Ahsoka season 2 is here, and it's packed with action. The show returns on January 20, 2027, with more Anakin Skywalker and big space fights.

articles.title: A Robot Friend That Stopped Working: What Happens When AI Toys Shut Down?
articles.summary: A kid named Xander had a robot friend called Moxie that helped him with feelings. But the company that made Moxie went out of business and turned off the robot's brain, leaving many kids sad.
